documents: Published paper: Liu, Zhang, Chen & Shi (2022), Earth and Space Science 9, e2022EA002325 (PDF, 15 pp.)

entry.evidence: So far, the reasons for the 2021 Maduo earthquake generating inside the BHB have remained unclear.

steps.action: Posed two questions: why the Maduo earthquake occurred inside the BHB, and how its stress change affects hazard on the surrounding parallel faults.
steps.quote: So far, the reasons for the 2021 Maduo earthquake generating inside the BHB have remained unclear.

steps.action: Took the 2021 Mw 7.3 Maduo earthquake, a live event, as the occasion to study fault interaction in a parallel strike-slip fault system.
steps.quote: The occurrence of the 2021 Mw 7.3 Maduo earthquake provides a good opportunity to explore the fault interaction process

steps.action: Compiled a catalog of 27 M ≥ 6.5 earthquakes from 1725 to 2021 with focal mechanisms, from historical records and the China Earthquake Data Center, including two large events outside the BHB.
steps.quote: Since 1725, approximately 25 earthquakes (M ≥ 6.5) have been recorded in the eastern BHB

steps.action: Built a layered viscoelastic lithosphere model from published imaging and viscosity estimates (μ′ = 0.4), then computed co- and postseismic ΔCFS from each historical event with PSGRN/PSCMP at 12 km depth on Maduo-type receiver faults.
steps.quote: we used the PSGRN/PSCMP code (Wang et al., 2003, 2006) to calculate the earthquake stress caused by the dislocation sources

steps.action: Computed individual and cumulative ΔCFS along the KPJF before and after 2021: about −125.9 kPa at the hypocenter (mainly −110 kPa from the 1937 event) and up to 109 kPa in the western seismic gap.
steps.quote: An ΔCFS of about −125.9 kPa was observed at the 2021 Maduo earthquake hypocenter

steps.action: Varied the calculation depth from 4 to 16 km for the KPJF results; the stress pattern held while the values changed (Figures S1-S2, Table S4).
steps.quote: The stress patterns at different depths along the KPJF were similar, whereas the stress values changed significantly.

steps.action: Computed the coseismic ΔCFS and the 100-year postseismic ΔCFS from the Maduo earthquake on 11 receiver faults, identifying shadow zone A and stress-increase zones B and C.
steps.quote: we calculated the ΔCFS in the 11 faults (F1–F11 in Figure 6) in the BHB induced only by the 2021 Maduo earthquake

steps.action: Varied depth for the 11-fault ΔCFS and reported the ranges of stress drop and increase (Figure S5).
steps.quote: The ΔCFS distribution along the 11 faults (F1–F11) at varying depths induced by the 2021 Maduo earthquake is presented in Figure S5

steps.action: Ran sensitivity tests on strike, dip, rake, friction coefficient (0.2-0.8), the Maduo focal mechanism and crust and mantle viscosities (Texts S4, S7), giving ranges in Table 2.
steps.quote: The present study also investigated the sensitivity of the stress results to model-dependent parameters

steps.action: Converted the hypocentral stress deficit into a delay time using a stressing rate of 0.8 kPa/a cited from Huang et al. (2021), giving about 157 years.
steps.quote: the ΔCFS (125.9 kPa) was equivalent to tectonic loading for approximately 157 years

steps.action: Compared the results with earlier ΔCFS calculations by Huang et al. (2021) and Zhu et al. (2021), found them congruent, and added per-event contributions.
steps.quote: Our findings are congruent with those of Huang et al. (2021) and Zhu et al. (2021)

steps.action: Rejected He, Feng et al.'s (2021) claim that the 1947 event promoted Maduo: the coseismic ΔCFS matches theirs (~0 kPa), but postseismic relaxation adds −14 kPa, about 18 years of delay.
steps.quote: the postseismic stress change at the 2021 Maduo earthquake hypocenter reached −14 kPa during 1974–2021

steps.action: Refined the delay estimate across all parameter cases (−77 to −150 kPa) to roughly 96-186 years, stated as 100-200 years.
steps.quote: the 2021 Maduo earthquake was significantly delayed for approximately 100–200 years

steps.action: Compared the simulated stress increase in the KPJF western gap (109 kPa) with a 10 kPa triggering threshold cited from Reasenberg and Simpson (1992), and inferred increased hazard there.
steps.quote: which is higher than the typical stress threshold of 10 kPa (Reasenberg & Simpson, 1992)

steps.action: Assessed the Maqin-Maqu gap (+9 kPa, equal to 18-45 years of loading at a stressing rate cited from Shan et al.) against previous studies and paleoseismic evidence, and found it consistent.
steps.quote: the ΔCFS increase of 9 kPa in the Maqin-Maqu seismic gap was equivalent to tectonic loading

steps.action: Compared the stress-increase zones with observed aftershocks (Mw 4.7 in the Maqin-Maqu gap, aftershocks in zone B, Mw 3.4 on the BYKF), noting that unknown focal mechanisms prevent a firm attribution.
steps.quote: it is difficult to determine whether some of the aftershocks were the triggered events

steps.action: Proposed a general mechanism: slip on one fault of a parallel strike-slip system inhibits earthquakes on the surrounding faults through a stress shadow, likened to Kato and Lei (2001).
steps.quote: we propose that earthquake slips on one fault of the parallel strike-slip fault system might inhibit seismic activities on the other surrounding faults

steps.action: Kept four conclusions: the delay of about 157 years, increased hazard in the gaps, the Maduo shadow on surrounding faults, and the proposed inhibition mechanism.
steps.quote: The 2021 Maduo earthquake was delayed for about 157 years due to the stress shadow on the KPJF

end.claim: The 2021 Maduo earthquake was delayed by about 157 years (100-200 years across parameter cases) by a stress shadow from historical earthquakes, mainly the 1937 EKLF and 1947 Dari events.

decisive_move.sentence: The viscoelastic (co- plus postseismic) ΔCFS simulation of 27 historical earthquakes on Maduo-type receiver faults produces the hypocentral stress deficit on which every claim rests.

gates.evidence: The catalog and model parameters come from existing databases and literature, not from acquisition directed by a hypothesis. The sign of the cumulative ΔCFS could in principle have been positive, and sensitivity tests show the deficit persists (−77 to −150 kPa). No independent observation tests the delay itself, and the aftershock comparison is qualitative. Nothing was stated as fixed before the computations.

imports.item: Coulomb failure criterion with an effective friction coefficient

novelty_claims.quote: stress transfers in a parallel strike-slip fault system and their influence on regional seismic activities have not been well studied
we determined the role of each event in either contributing to or delaying the 2021 Maduo earthquake

limits: Coded from the published paper only; the acknowledgments mention two reviewers and an editor, but no review file was supplied, so no review sequence is coded. Sub-claims and their statuses: increased hazard in the western KPJF gap, the Maqin-Maqu gap and the XZDF/MDGF segments rests on simulated ΔCFS exceeding a cited 10 kPa threshold (best_explanation at most). The Maduo-induced shadow on surrounding faults is estimate_with_resolution (Table 2 ranges). The general inhibition mechanism for parallel strike-slip systems is proposed, not tested (status none). The rejection of He, Feng et al. (2021) is a secondary contradiction; I coded the headline outcome as kept rather than contradicted because the contradiction depends on model viscosities and was not tested independently (my judgement). The delay in years depends entirely on a single stressing rate cited from Huang et al. (2021); no alternative rate is examined. Background stress before 1725 is ignored. Supplementary texts (S4, S7, Tables S1-S11) were not supplied, so the details of the sensitivity cases cannot be checked. The aftershock comparison has no statistical test. The composition is none_fits because the walk is a single forward-model stress calculation on found conditions, with robustness checks and no repeated independent traces or crucial test. That the step order follows the order of the work is an inference from the paper's layout.

disagreements.target: He, Feng, et al. (2021): the 2021 Maduo earthquake was promoted by the 1947 Mw 7.75 earthquake
disagreements.support: Their coseismic value (~0 kPa) is reproduced (−0.3 kPa), but adding the viscoelastic postseismic relaxation they neglected gives −14 kPa at the hypocenter, a delay of about 18 years.
disagreements.quote: [...] are contrary to the proposal by He, Feng, et al. (2021) that the 2021 Maduo earthquake was promoted

disagreements.target: Zhu et al. (2021): ΔCFS on the KPJF from the 1937 and 1947 earthquakes
disagreements.support: The results agree, but this paper resolves each event's contribution by computing the events individually, which Zhu et al. did not detail.
disagreements.quote: the magnitudes of the stress released by the two events were not detailed by Zhu et al. (2021)

alternatives_considered.alternatives: Elastic, coseismic-only calculation (as in He, Feng et al. 2021)
alternatives_considered.reason: Previous studies stress the importance of postseismic stress from viscous relaxation in the deep crust and mantle

alternatives_considered.chosen: Effective friction coefficient μ′ = 0.4 (King et al., 1994)
Middle and lower crust viscosities of 4.0 × 10^20 and 5.0 × 10^19 Pa·s (Shi & Cao, 2008)
alternatives_considered.alternatives: Other values within a realistic range

alternatives_considered.reason: Suggested hypocenter depth of the 2021 Maduo earthquake

alternatives_considered.chosen: Receiver faults with the USGS focal mechanism of the Maduo earthquake
alternatives_considered.alternatives: Other focal mechanisms of the Maduo earthquake and varied strike, dip and rake

alternatives_considered.chosen: Including two large earthquakes outside the BHB (1920 Haiyuan, 1927 Gulang)
alternatives_considered.alternatives: Restricting the catalog to events in and near the BHB
